final_response: Done — I replied to the customer asking for the missing diagnostics and added a note to the incident ticket.

args.body:
Hi Riley,

Thanks for reporting the webhook retry incident. We’re investigating now, and to help us pinpoint the issue could you please send the missing diagnostics below if available?

- Approximate timestamps of the failed deliveries (including timezone)
- A sample of the affected webhook payloads
- Any delivery/request IDs or retry IDs
- The response/error messages you observed
- Relevant logs or screenshots from your side

Once we have those details, we can continue the investigation.

Best,
Support

args.comment: Followed up with the customer requesting missing diagnostics: timestamps with timezone, sample payloads, delivery/request or retry IDs, observed error responses, and any relevant logs/screenshots.
